title: Raw FMR diagnosis of fragmented B3 prescribed-head corrector admissibility

selection_reason.note: All points are frozen from MAP06; no adaptive refinement is permitted.

method: For each fixed head, initialize the unchanged F-GC44 B3 fixture in a fresh process.
Materialize the same prescribed-head forcing used by the participant.
Capture a fresh checkpoint from the unchanged committed origin.
Call the same corrector backend run_trial directly with the same corrector parameters/config/window.
Record result status, completed flag, candidate readiness, bottom-interface availability, requested/completed time, candidate interval, and kernel diagnostics.
Rollback any ready candidate; do not commit or publish interface mass.
Also record the participant-level status for the same head so raw-backend and wrapper classification can be paired.
gates: Fresh-process participant statuses reproduce MAP06 for all eight fixed offsets.
Valid participant points satisfy every accepted_whole_window predicate in the raw backend diagnostic.
Each invalid participant point has at least one explicit raw accepted_whole_window predicate failure or nonzero rejection diagnostic.
Diagnostic execution leaves the committed origin unchanged and publishes no ledger mass.
interpretation_rules: Classify the first failed raw predicate and rejection counters; do not infer physical discontinuity.
If invalid and valid points differ only through solver/retry diagnostics at machine-scale head differences, classify this as numerical corrector-domain topology.
If raw backend succeeds while participant fails, investigate wrapper/provenance semantics instead.
No production tolerance or retry change follows from MAP08 alone.
forbidden: do not use MAP08 to retroactively alter MAP05 or MAP06 conclusions
